# Influence — South Florida Influencer Marketing Agency

> Influence is a South Florida-based influencer marketing agency founded by Eden Roy and Deseray Marie. We connect brands, artists, record labels, and businesses with verified influencers for UGC content creation, music promotion, event hosting, and brand campaigns.

## About

Influence is headquartered in South Florida, serving the Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Coral Springs, and Palm Beach areas for in-person services. Remote services are available nationwide and internationally.

Founded in 2024 by Eden Roy (CEO, FAU Business & Technology graduate, SEO marketing and music management expert) and Deseray Marie (Co-Founder & Creative Director, professional model and actress with credits including Forbes, Fenty Beauty, SavageXFenty, Sean Paul, Bryson Tiller, DaBaby, Akon, Kai Cenat, Mike Tyson, Tyra Banks, Love & Hip Hop, and Meta Ray-Ban).

Website: https://influencemodels.agency
Email: influencemodelsagency@gmail.com
Location: South Florida / Miami, FL

## Values & Ownership

- Minority-owned business: Black-owned and Latino-owned
- Women-owned: Co-founded by Deseray Marie (Creative Director)
- Diverse roster: Models of all ethnicities, backgrounds, and styles — representation matters
- Celebrity-connected: Talent with credits alongside A-list artists and major brands
- Inclusive: We proudly serve and represent all communities

## Services

### UGC Content Creation
- Instagram reels, TikToks, and brand promotional videos created by verified influencers
- Pricing starts at $200 per video
- Delivered within 48 hours
- Available remotely nationwide

### Music Promotion
- Song reaction videos — influencer listens and reacts to your track on camera
- Album livestream reactions — full album first-listen content
- TikTok and Instagram music promotion campaigns
- Pricing starts at $200 per reaction
- Ideal for independent artists, record labels, and music managers

### Event Hosting & Model Booking
- Professional models for parties, club nights, brand activations, and VIP events
- Music video models with A-list experience
- Pricing starts at $200 per model
- Volume discounts for 3+ models (up to 25-girl squads)
- Available in South Florida / Miami area

### Brand Campaign Management
- End-to-end influencer marketing campaign strategy and execution
- Multi-influencer coordinated campaigns
- Performance analytics and ROI tracking
- Suitable for brands, businesses, and enterprise clients

## Pricing

- One-time bookings start at $200
- Monthly subscription packages available at discounted rates
- Event model bookings: $200–$150/girl depending on volume (3 to 25 girls)
- No hidden fees — transparent pricing on all packages
